import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}assessment-responses`;// Get
const getAssessmentResponses=async()=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL);return response.data;};// Get
const getExternalResponses=async status=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL+"?type=external&status="+status);return response.data;};// Delete 
const deleteAssessmentResponse=async id=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+id);return response.data;};const updateAssessmentResponse=async(id,data)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+id,data);return response.data;};// Create 
const createAssessmentResponse=async data=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,data);return response.data;};const assessmentResponseService={createAssessmentResponse,getAssessmentResponses,deleteAssessmentResponse,updateAssessmentResponse,getExternalResponses};export default assessmentResponseService;
